name: clearfeed-youtube-members-hider
description: Manifest V3 Chrome extension that hides Members-only content on YouTube.

scripts.dev: node -e "import('node:http').then(async ({default:http})=>{const fs=await import('node:fs');const path=await import('node:path');const types={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.png':'image/png','.json':'application/json','.zip':'application/zip'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{const url=(req.url||'/').split('?')[0];if(url==='/'){res.writeHead(302,{Location:'/src/popup.html'});return res.end();}const fp=path.resolve(url.replace(/^\//,''));if(!fp.startsWith(process.cwd())||!fs.existsSync(fp)||fs.statSync(fp).isDirectory()){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not found');}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(fp)]||'application/octet-stream'});fs.createReadStream(fp).pipe(res);}).listen(3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('Extension popup preview on :3000'));})"
